body_markdown:
#


THE CHAMPS


####


NOW AVAILABLE THE TRAILER AND KEY ART FOR THE NEW FILM STARRING


###


ALESSANDRO GASSMANN AND ANNA FERZETTI


COMING ONLY ON NETFLIX ON DECEMBER 15


####


[KEY ART](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/001fafe6-327e-4c7b-8696-cef3a2081a21) |


[IMAGES](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/1b62564b-1a5c-4b3c-a0b0-a5de612eb4ef) |


[TRAILER](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3MyweZO9Up8)


######


Credits: Andrea Pirrello/Netflix


The


trailer


and


key art


for


The Champs


— the film directed by


Jacopo Bonvicini


, starring


Alessandro Gassmann and Anna Ferzetti


, coming only on Netflix on


December 15, 2026 —


are now available.


Produced by Groenlandia, a Banijay group company,


The Champs


is a comedy that uses the world of sport to tell a story of encounters, human connection and personal growth.


Marco is a restless, immature basketball coach whose terrible attitude, both on the court and in his private life, costs him his job and lands him in trouble with the police. To avoid prison, Marco is forced to do community service: coaching a basketball team made up of young neurodivergent people at a parish in the province of Bologna. Initially reluctant and unprepared for this new challenge, he gradually discovers a different way of experiencing sport and human relationships. Through daily contact with the team – between practices, games, clashes and new bonds – Marco and his players get to know one another and find a new balance, on and off the court.


The Champs


is a remake of


Campeones


, the Spanish film that won two Goya Awards in 2019 and was a major box-office hit, grossing over €23 million.


CREDITS


The cast also includes Giuseppe Gandini, Francesco Brandi, Flaminia Pricolo, Giordano Capparucci, Massimiliano Rodolfo, Carlo Di Bartolomeo, Alessandro Jimi Masperi, Aitalina Paduraru, Filippo Aureli, Ermanno Curti, Matteo Zanotti, Arturo Gabbriellini, with Betti Pedrazzi and Antonio Gerardi.


DIRECTOR


Jacopo Bonvicini


SCREENPLAY


Giulia Louise Steigerwalt, Sofia Assirelli


PRODUCTION


Andrea Paris and Matteo Rovere for Groenlandia, a Banijay group company.
